topics.summary: During this broadcast, David Dalton repeatedly demands recognition for his radio work and makes outlandish claims regarding his influence. He engages in bizarre conversations, including an awkward interview with John List, while fixating on the perceived lack of awards despite significant achievements like a successful national morning show simulcast.

topics.title: Robert Blake's Erratic Interview
topics.summary: During an erratic radio interview, Robert Blake discusses his troubled past including allegations of abuse by his parents and drug use. He talks about tumultuous childhood experiences, claims numerous talk show appearances, and bizarre tangents regarding sex and actresses before taking a break to discuss the John List story.

topics.title: Robert Blake’s Unhinged Radio Callers
topics.summary: During a radio segment featuring Robert Blake, callers attempt to elicit details about his past affairs with Hollywood starlets and his troubled childhood. The conversation quickly descends into bizarre tangents involving fantasies of sex with Kathie Lee Gifford, an obsession with Mandela, and increasingly inappropriate suggestions regarding oral sex, ultimately escalating into demands for him to perform the act.
